cim_eredeti: Collective, which uses AI to automate bookkeeping for solo business owners, raised a $40M Series B and $60M in nondilutive capital from GC's Customer Value Fund (Natalie Breymeyer/Axios)
szoveg_eredeti:
Collective, a financial services platform for solo business owners, secured $100 million in financing, CEO Hooman Radfar tells Axios.

The big picture: AI is allowing entrepreneurs to build and run businesses with fewer employees.
